# Pull request

Thank you for contributing. Please complete the sections below so reviewers can understand and
verify the change.

Use a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) PR title, such as
`feat: add token authentication` or `fix(cli): preserve command timeouts`.

## Why

Describe the problem or opportunity this change addresses.

- How was it discovered?
- For a bug fix, include reproduction steps and link the relevant issue.

## How

Describe how the change works.

- Call out important design decisions or reviewer considerations.
- Mention alternatives considered and why this approach was chosen.

## Test

Describe the tests and verification performed, including relevant commands and results.
